content.text:
The box Chrome is already signed into Google. There are two tabs: an inactive tab titled "Clients - Google Auth Plat..." and the active tab is chat.google.com.

Do this and stop:
1. Switch to the existing Clients tab (Google Auth Platform). If it is stale, go to https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients?project=argon-bulwark-491118-j2
2. Open the Web application OAuth client whose client ID contains `1mthtgbtth61t3deoktohjlutdq0gkdt` (full ID: 58089599401-1mthtgbtth61t3deoktohjlutdq0gkdt.apps.googleusercontent.com). If that exact client is missing, open the Web client that looks like the one created for Cursor/Chat. Do NOT open a service account.
3. Under Authorized redirect URIs, add these two if they are not already present (exact, no trailing slash):
   - https://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callback
   - http://localhost:8787/callback
4. Save the client.
5. If Google requires an Authorized domain for cursor.com, go to Google Auth Platform → Branding and add `cursor.com` if missing, then save.
6. Also check Google Auth Platform → Audience: if the app is External and in Testing, note that. Do not change Audience unless you must add a test user to save.

Do not send messages in Google Chat. Do not create a new OAuth client unless the Web client truly does not exist.

Return: whether the two redirect URIs were added and saved, the client name/ID you edited, any Branding/Audience issue, and a short description of the final screen.
I'll start by checking the tabs.
